d: Euro Mechanical is an Abu Dhabi-based oil and gas group, proudly marking 50 years in 2026. Our people are the reason clients keep coming back to us. We work by four beliefs: Proficient, Reliable, Collaborative and with Integrity.
q: li
A bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.
li
A minimum of 6 years of core design and detailed engineering experience in the oil and gas or energy sector.
li
An extensive track record in the design, engineering and modular packaging of chemical injection skids, process packages, fuel gas conditioning skids or pressure equipment.
li
Detailed knowledge of mechanical design systems, specifically for process packages.
li
In-depth working knowledge of ASME Section VIII, Divisions 1 and 2; ASME B31.3; API standards, including API 674/675/676 and API 610; and AWS/AISC structural codes.
li
In-depth working knowledge of regional operator specifications, notably ADNOC and regional GCC oil and gas standards.
li
Strong computer skills in CADWorx/SolidWorks/Inventor, Microsoft Office and AutoCAD.
li
Strong written and spoken communication, interpersonal and leadership skills, with the ability to support draftspeople and coordinate across disciplines.
li
Familiarity with oil and gas working practices and a strong commitment to quality, HSE, integrity and continuous improvement.
r: We are looking for a Design Engineer (Remote) to join our Engineering team within the Manufacturing business unit. You will perform mechanical calculations, size equipment, develop 3D models and prepare fabrication-ready drawings for modular process systems, chemical dosing packages and pressurised skids, translating project specifications and client requirements into practical engineering deliverables from project award to handover.
Develop and maintain clash-free 3D skid models covering piping, structural members, valve access, davits, junction boxes and instrumentation.
Carry out mechanical design calculations for lifting lugs and structural integrity in line with applicable codes.
Supervise and support draftspeople in preparing general arrangements, equipment layouts, piping isometrics, bills of materials and shop fabrication drawings.
Extract accurate material take-offs for piping, structural steel, valves and accessories to support procurement and avoid excess inventory.
Verify operating and maintenance clearances for valves, pumps, instruments and filter replacement against client specifications and ergonomic requirements.
Review vendor fabrication drawings and incorporate approved vendor data into the package design.
Participate in project kick-off meetings, technical reviews, HAZOPs and 30%, 60% and 90% model reviews; record actions and close review comments.
Support fabrication, assembly and testing teams by resolving technical queries, reviewing redline mark-ups and preparing final as-built drawings.
Review engineering-related nonconformities and propose technical solutions.
Conduct site surveys and support product development by identifying design risks and opportunities to improve existing product lines.
x: Be part of a company with 50 years of delivery in the UAE oil and gas sector.
Contribute to mechanical design for modular process packages, chemical injection systems and pressurised skids.
Follow your designs through modelling, fabrication, assembly, testing and final handover.
Collaborate with engineering, project and production teams to improve constructability and solve practical design challenges.
Please click Apply and submit your CV. We will be in touch with all shortlisted candidates.

d: The Item Master Specialist is responsible for the creation, maintenance, governance, and continuous improvement of item master data within the ERP system. The role ensures the accurate classification, standardization, and coding of materials, equipment, spare parts, and services to support procurement, inventory management, warehouse operations, financial reporting, and business decision-making. Acting as a key custodian of master data integrity, the position collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to maintain standardized item information, enforce data governance principles, eliminate duplicate records, and ensure compliance with organizational policies, industry standards, and audit requirements. The role operates with a high degree of independence in managing item coding activities and resolving data quality issues while escalating complex exceptions to management.
q: li
Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
li
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in item master data management, supply chain, procurement, inventory control, warehouse operations, or a related discipline.
li
Experience working within construction, engineering, industrial, manufacturing, or project-based environments is preferred.
li
Proficiency in ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent enterprise platforms.
li
Strong knowledge of item master data management principles, governance frameworks, and data quality standards.
li
Understanding of inventory management, procurement processes, warehouse operations, and supply chain best practices.
li
Knowledge of item classification methodologies, including UNSPSC, commodity codes, material groups, and cataloging standards.
li
Ability to interpret technical specifications, engineering drawings, data sheets, manufacturer catalogs, and equipment documentation.
li
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools for data analysis, validation, and performance monitoring.
li
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with the ability to identify and resolve data discrepancies.
li
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high levels of data accuracy and integrity.
li
Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
li
Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
li
Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills across Procurement, Engineering, Warehouse, Finance, and Operations functions.
li
Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and maintain confidentiality when handling business-critical data.
li
Knowledge of internal controls, audit requirements, ISO standards, and master data governance practices.
li
Experience in data cleansing, duplicate identification, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
li
Professional certifications such as APICS, CSCP, CIPS, DAMA, or equivalent certifications are considered an advantage.
r: Create, maintain, and update item master records within the ERP system.
Review, validate, and process item creation, modification, and deactivation requests.
Assign and maintain item codes in accordance with established naming conventions, classification standards, and data governance requirements.
Classify materials, equipment, spare parts, and services using approved commodity and categorization structures (e.g., UNSPSC and material groups).
Verify item descriptions, technical specifications, units of measure, manufacturer details, and part numbers for accuracy and completeness.
Identify, analyze, and eliminate duplicate item records to maintain master data integrity.
Collaborate with Procurement, Warehouse, Engineering, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure accurate item identification and classification.
Establish and maintain standardized item descriptions and coding frameworks across the organization.
Conduct periodic master data audits, cleansing activities, and data quality reviews.
Monitor and improve item master data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and compliance.
Generate reports and analytics related to item master activities, pending requests, duplicate records, and data quality metrics.
Develop, maintain, and enhance item master data policies, procedures, work instructions, and governance documentation.
Support inventory optimization, ERP enhancement initiatives, and supply chain improvement projects.
Provide guidance, training, and user support on item coding standards, classification methodologies, and master data processes.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies, internal controls, audit requirements, and applicable ISO standards.
Develop and monitor KPIs and dashboards related to item master performance and data quality management.
Investigate and resolve item master data issues, discrepancies, and classification conflicts.
Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening master data governance and operational efficiency.
Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.
